purpose: Index of the doc-link design documents DES-001 to DES-010, stating what each covers and the principle that design must not override requirements.
summary: Requirements are the source of truth for behavior and constraints; design is for subjects, information, states and processing
If requirements and design conflict, design alone does not override requirements
Table of DES-001 to DES-010 with the content each covers
DES-001 covers system boundary, overall sequence and common invariants
DES-002 to DES-004 cover execution subjects, data model and state machines
DES-005 to DES-007 cover ToC building, search, and references with impact notification
DES-008 to DES-010 cover content rules, verification design, and SKILL and Agent composition
Diagrams are for understanding; the transition table in DES-004 is normative
tasks: Finding which design document covers a topic
Resolving conflicts between requirements and design
title: doc-link 設計書の構成
